newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat futures mixed, switches up volume.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat futures mixed, switches up volume.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures ended mixed, with volume bolstered by switching out of front month January into March and May, traders said.
They identified some shipper buying in forward months. "People get frustrated. They find they can't get grain in the physical markets and they come to the futures market to get coverage," one said.
Front month Jan was the most active, with 244 lots traded. It last traded up 0.05 stg at 93.75 stg per tonne. Total volume for wheat was 608 lots.
Switches helped widen the January-March and January-May spreads, with March last traded up 0.10 stg at 95.80 stg and May last traded up 0.15 stg at 97.45 stg.
Barley volume was minimal with just 51 lots changing hands in total. Most of that was on Jan, which last traded 0.10 stg lower at 92.25 stg.
Some felt news that Jordan is to tender on December 19 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. or equivalent feed barley for shipment by the end of January helped the barley market.
